issues: ThemeContext defaults to system preference first (prefers-color-scheme: light -> light), only falls back to dark otherwise. Spec explicitly says 'Default theme on first visit = dark'. On a headless/Playwright browser (which reports prefers-color-scheme=light by default), the site loads in LIGHT mode on a truly first visit, not the intended luxury Dark Gold. If strict spec compliance is required, remove the media-query branch and always default to dark unless localStorage has a saved 'light'.

Drawer computed style shows backdrop-filter: none and solid background rgb(253,251,247). Nav DOES have backdrop-blur(40px), but the cart drawer body itself did not — spec calls for frosted glassmorphism on 'sticky nav / drawers / payment'. Consider adding backdrop-blur/translucent bg to the drawer aside element (likely a Sheet/aside class). Minor visual polish.

ThemeContext.jsx conflates 'system-preference auto-detect' with 'default dark' — both flags are set, but only one can win on first visit. Consider disambiguating in ThemeContext or spec.
